principals.name: A
principals.description: the initiator: holds the long-term key KA shared with AS, decrypts AS's response, forwards B's ticket, and answers B's CK-protected nonce challenge.

principals.name: B
principals.description: the correspondent: holds the long-term key KB shared with AS, decrypts the ticket, generates a nonce challenge under CK, and verifies A's response.

principals.name: AS
principals.description: the trusted authentication server: holds the long-term keys KA and KB, generates the fresh conversation key CK, and sends A an encrypted response containing B's ticket.

values.name: KA
values.description: KA is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.

values.name: KB
values.description: KB is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.
